notes: Family note for the aggregator: test69 is the normalization member of the V5 interval family (test23, test24, test27, test30, test46, test47, test48, test78, test87 share the extend helper). Its distinguishing feature is that the intervals are equalised rather than existential: the t bounds [0, L] re-encode the 3,000 containment rows, and 6,446 surviving gate rows are additionally strengthened by a box-tight inactive-case argument, which is what needs the Cases template rather than a further lift. Nothing about resource limits binds here (work 2.79M of 1e9, peak live facts 17,383 of 1e6, RPA 10.4 MB of 256 MiB), so preflight/multi-part assembly are not needs; the cost is authoring volume and text duplication. The kernel's own receipt shows the lift generates 6,000 rows for 1,500 intervals, i.e. exactly the four premises the preparer hand-built and then matched back to source rows.
